name: American Healthcare Systems

ahrq.src: AHRQ Compendium of U.S. Health Systems, 2023, matched to CMS's hospital list (the site's June 2026 pull)

hc.src: Medicare hospital cost reports (CMS HCRIS, Worksheet S-3), fiscal year 2024 file

subs: Beds on its Medicare cost report. A licensed bed count usually runs higher.
Every intensive and special care unit counts: adult, cardiac, surgical, burn, neonatal and pediatric.
Each inpatient stay that ended counts once, whoever paid for it.
All inpatient days divided by discharges. Answer in days, like 4.5.
Patient days divided by the bed days it had available.
Medicare Advantage plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Medicaid managed care plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payroll only: not clinics, not contract staff.
From AHRQ's 2023 list of who owns which hospital, matched to Medicare's hospital list.
Every one of its hospitals' latest Medicare cost report, added up.
Biggest by beds on its cost report. The answer names the hospital.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payrolls only: clinics, offices and any health plan are left out.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Vista Medical Center East have on its payroll in fiscal 2024?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 American Healthcare Systems hospitals; Randolph Hospital has the most, 846. About 4.1 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Gateway Regional Medical Center have on its payroll in 2024?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 American Healthcare Systems hospitals; Randolph Hospital has the most, 846. About 2.0 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Randolph Hospital have on its payroll in 2024?
questions.why: No other American Healthcare Systems hospital reports more; Vista Medical Center East is next at 674. About 5.8 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees do American Healthcare Systems's hospitals have on payroll, added together?
questions.why: From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.

questions.q: How many hospitals does American Healthcare Systems run, by the federal list of health systems?
questions.why: Illinois 2 and North Carolina 1. A system's own count can differ: it may count campuses on their own, or hospitals that joined after 2023.

questions.why: Illinois and North Carolina.

questions.q: How many American Healthcare Systems hospitals are in North Carolina, by the federal list?
